host: Apple M3 Max, 36 GiB; Docker Desktop Linux ARM64 guest; not an x86 production server
data: 24 existing authored PDF cases, 26 rendered pages, nine languages; includes correlated degraded variants, not independent real-world scans
input: Identical frozen RGB PNGs rendered with PDFium at 200 DPI; no reference-dependent engine settings or text correction
language_selection: Tesseract always loads eng+swe+fra+deu+spa+dan+pol+tur+chi_sim; other engines use fixed multilingual models; Latin model retained as a coverage control
resources: One active benchmark worker/container at a time; 1 CPU quota, 4 GiB memory limit, 256 process limit, no GPU, native thread settings 1; network disabled
sequence: Profile order shuffled with seed 20261111; each process does one excluded full-corpus warm-up then five complete sequential corpus passes; profiles are not interleaved, to avoid concurrent resident model memory
timing: Sum of per-document worker wall times, median across five passes. Includes PNG loading, image conversion and recognition. Excludes PDF rendering, model initialization, output serialization, IPC and BulkParse layout reconstruction
cpu: Sum of worker process user+system CPU seconds from getrusage RUSAGE_SELF, including native threads; median across five passes
memory: Maximum process ru_maxrss across initialization, warm-up and measured passes, Linux KiB converted to bytes. Includes imports and models; excludes container daemon and page cache; container memory limit includes other memory
startup: Initialization seconds and container launch-to-ready measured separately once; filesystem cache not purged, so not disk-cold measurements
quality: First measured pass; micro CER/WER from Levenshtein distance after Unicode NFC and whitespace normalization, case/accent/punctuation sensitive. Blank insertions counted and blank false positives reported separately. Engine reading order retained. Errors remain as empty text. All runs checked for text changes
differences: RapidOCR and RapidOCRLite use the existing line-orientation classifier and .5 text score. Official Paddle disables orientation/unwarping and uses .5 text score, tiny/tiny or small/small models, MKLDNN disabled for ARM portability. Rapid medium uses small detector and medium recognizer. Tesseract uses AUTO page segmentation and LSTM_ONLY
limits: Small synthetic corpus; only Latin-script languages and one Chinese example. No Arabic, Indic, Cyrillic, handwriting, orientation, table-structure or full-page scan evaluation. Raw OCR-stage outputs differ from existing end-to-end BulkParse OCR benchmarks. Timing conclusions require confirmation on production CPU architecture
